label: Whatever causes a perfection in another thing has it
paraphrase: Analyst formulation, attribution deferred (distinct-cause transfer): whatever, distinct from x, causes x's being r (CausesIn c x r) is itself in act as to r (InAct c r, formally or eminently, the inclusive InAct of DISAMB-IN-ACT). It is the unrestricted 'nothing gives what it does not have' STMT-CAUSE-HAS-WHAT-IT-GIVES without its self-causation case (registered strength order, strict in control 3). Two results of this batch relate it to the 'more such' premise: 'more such' with STMT-MORE-SUCH-HAS-THE-PERFECTION entails it, and it with the five-premise reception bundle entails 'more such'. Any route using 'more such' at an arbitrary perfection together with STMT-MORE-SUCH-HAS-THE-PERFECTION is committed to distinct-cause transfer; conversely transfer with the reception bundle suffices for 'more such'. It differs from the cause-of-being restriction STMT-CAUSE-OF-BEING-HAS-WHAT-IT-GIVES in scope (control 2): it covers causes of a perfection of a thing whose being they do not cause, so the instrument objection (a chisel causes a shape it has neither formally nor as art) and the artisan case (a maker causes a shape he has only as art) bear on it if CAUSE_2 counts instruments or makers, unless 'has' is read so that having r eminently includes having an art or a principal agent's power to produce r. No independent warrant is recorded for it.
